memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Be careful to follow every command I am giving you today, so that you may live and increase and may enter and possess the land the Lord promised on oath to your ancestors. Remember how the Lord your God led you all the way in the wilderness these forty years, to humble and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep his commands. - Deut 8:1-2 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses calls Israel to look back over the whole journey — the forty years of wandering in the wilderness — and to see God's hand in all of it. He tells them plainly why God led them that long, hard way: "to humble and test you in order to know what was in your heart." The wilderness was not a detour or a mistake. It was God's classroom, revealing and shaping what was really inside His people.

This reframes how we understand our own hard seasons. We often view difficult stretches of life as wasted time, as if the "real" life will begin once the trial is over. But God frequently uses wilderness seasons deliberately, to humble us, to expose what is truly in our hearts, and to teach us to depend on Him. The testing is not meant to destroy us but to reveal us to ourselves and to draw us closer to Him.

God already knew Israel's hearts, of course. The testing was for their sake — so that they, and we, would come to see what we are really made of, and where our trust really lies. Trials have a way of surfacing what comfort keeps hidden. If you are in a wilderness season now, take heart: God has not abandoned you there. He is leading you "all the way," using even this to humble, teach, and mature you. Nothing in your journey is wasted in His hands (Rom 8:28).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- How do I tend to view the hard seasons of my life — as wasted, or as God's classroom?
- What has a "wilderness" time revealed about what is truly in my heart?
- Can I trust that God is leading me "all the way," even through the difficult stretch?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that no part of my journey is wasted in Your hands. In the wilderness seasons, humble me, teach me, and show me what is truly in my heart, drawing me closer to depend on You. Amen.
